definitions.gloss: metropolis, big city, large urban area
definitions.explanation: A very large city with a high population and extensive urban development. Examples include Tokyo, New York, London, etc.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}は{世界的|せかいてき}な{大都会|だいとかい}だ。
{大都会|だいとかい}での{生活|せいかつ}は{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: Life in a big city is busy.

examples.japanese: {大都会|だいとかい}から{田舎|いなか}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: I moved from the big city to the countryside.

notes:
COMPOUND: {大|だい} (big) + {都会|とかい} (city)

RELATED TERMS:
- {都会|とかい} (city, urban area)
- {都市|とし} (city - more formal)
- {田舎|いなか} (countryside, rural area)
- {郊外|こうがい} (suburbs)
- {首都|しゅと} (capital city)

{大都会|だいとかい} implies not just any city but specifically a major metropolitan area with millions of people, extensive infrastructure, and significant economic activity.
